```plato

    // The quadrilateral face table of the whole grid, one row per cell.
    GridFaceLoops(self: ClothGrid3D): Array<Array<VertexIndex>>
    {
        var columns = (self.ColumnCount - 1).Max(0);
        var rows = (self.RowCount - 1).Max(0);
        return (columns * rows).MapRange(n => self.GridQuad(n % columns, n / columns));
    }
```
